scientific_integrity: The proof uses the published exact sharp-bound representation and endpoint density expansion, then applies an explicit logarithmic change of variables, a gamma integral, a two-sided endpoint sandwich, and Stirling asymptotics. Exact repeated-minimal-parameter examples replay the constants without simulation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the sharp generalized-order-statistic moment bound only when the minimal parameter delta is at most one. It does not analyze the distinct delta>1 optimizer or change the published finiteness criterion. The novelty claim is limited to the critical blow-up rate and leading constant.
title: Critical blow-up law for sharp generalized-order-statistic moment bounds
